object: A hord is a git repository with Hoard's metadata overlay.  It contains a content/ directory (cards), a .hord/ directory (compiled quads, vocabulary, configuration), and optionally a lib/ directory (blobs — PDFs, images, assets).  The hord is the unit of cloning, sharing, and collaboration.
